teach.narration_en: Sukoon is the little circle that means 'no vowel here' — the letter just stops, closing the syllable. بَ is open (ba), بْ is closed (b). Watch for five letters especially — ق ط ب ج د — they get a little bounce when sukoon lands on them. That bounce has a name, and you'll master it fully in the Tajweed track: qalqalah.
teach.focus_en: Sukoon closes a syllable — no vowel, sound stops.
